notes: Initial public requirements set derived from published product claims and architecture docs. Statuses are Design Intent or Implemented — none are marked Verified solely because code exists.

requirements.title: Local-first operation
requirements.text: The system shall operate primarily on hardware controlled by the operator, with agent identity and memory persisted locally.
requirements.rationale: Public product promise: Your agents. Your hardware. Your data.

requirements.title: Persistent agents
requirements.text: The system shall support creating and managing persistent agents with separate conversation history and long-term memory.
requirements.rationale: Core Lite capability listed as available at install finish.

requirements.title: Provider-neutral capability routing
requirements.text: The system shall allow swapping LLM/TTS/STT backends without changing agent identity configuration.

requirements.title: VRAM-tier default model selection
requirements.text: Default Model installation shall select an Ollama chat model tier based on detected VRAM: under 6GB → qwen2.5:1.5b; ≥6 → 3b; ≥8 → 7b; ≥16 → 14b.

requirements.title: CPU-capable Lite path
requirements.text: Lite shall remain operable without a dedicated GPU by selecting a smaller local model configuration.

requirements.title: Local Ollama interface
requirements.text: Chat Default Model path shall communicate with a local Ollama endpoint on the operator machine.
requirements.rationale: Documented loopback endpoint for Default Model.

requirements.title: No vendor account dependency for local operation
requirements.text: Lite, AI9, and Expansion foundation layers shall not require authentication against OtaconsKeep operator private accounts for local operation.

requirements.title: Windows one-click install resume
requirements.text: Windows Setup shall request reboot when WSL2 enablement requires it and resume installation afterward rather than restarting from zero.

requirements.title: Emotional continuity state vector
requirements.text: Where emotional continuity is enabled, each agent shall maintain a bounded continuous state vector including irritation, jealousy, hurt, trust, attachment, confidence, and anxiety.
requirements.rationale: Implemented in continuity/emotional_continuity.py (Expansion / Reference Keep depth).

requirements.title: Asymmetric emotional inertia
requirements.text: Emotional updates shall use asymmetric inertia so provocation accrues more readily than repair recovers for high-inertia personalities.

requirements.title: Agent relationship Formula 5
requirements.text: Agent-to-agent relationship strength updates shall follow Formula 5: new = clamp(cur + delta - 0.008*(cur - 0.50), 0, 1).

requirements.title: Installer honesty on incomplete lab proof
requirements.text: Public documentation shall not claim full Windows WSL end-to-end release-gate proof while the automated lab path remains unconfirmed.
